name: sessions-enclave-gateway
description: The Sessions GATEWAY: the small, fully open-source enclave that holds the armed Telegram session and is the only component that can call Telegram through it. Its source IS the complete, exclusive capability ceiling.
comment: Self-contained EIF build context (spec 6.5): zero imports from private monorepo packages. The published mirror sessionsfyi/enclave-gateway is a byte-exact copy of this directory at the built release tag. The brain, app, and State Authority service are NEVER in it.
